source: query-phrasing workflow, run 44792452695 (DataForSEO, US and GB markets, en)
method: Each text names the observed phrasings it follows. 'observed': people type that form; 'adapted': the form is observed but reworded so the slot works for any noun, a person or a place, without a plural or an article that depends on it; 'unsupported': no query in the data.

can_recommend.note: the article follows the noun ('a dentist', 'an attorney'), so 'a good' carries it

recommend_a.note: the article follows the noun, so 'a good' carries it
